## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: quiesce/seal then actual finish with
   created-origin M1 (partition X4; PADR-R5-1 A.1 item 3 + A.5/A.9;
   REQ-E-203/REQ-E-102 primary). Reuse lower-layer codecs/stores; consume
   predecessor contracts unchanged (AC-1, AC-2).
2. Positive: stop participant access, drain observed/unknown, finalize
   charges + immutable submission, then persist actual finish; M1 uses the
   persisted created origin incl. adoption/waits/resume; postterminal
   instrument delay does not inflate M1 (AC-1).
3. Negative: crash before/after seal or finish, post-seal mutation,
   revocation failure, unresolved drain, rollback/untrustworthy restart,
   delayed adoption — truthful refusal/unknown; no backdated finish or
   grading a mutable submission (AC-2).
4. Ownership/evidence: REQ-E-203 + REQ-E-102 primary resolved to numbered
   checks + actual evidence; contributors REQ-E-103/REQ-E-201/REQ-E-204
   mapped; achieved D/E separate from owed R/P/actual-execution E;
   contributor evidence owed to R5.11/R5.14/R5.13/R5.9/R5.43 (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: fails-without regression; `cargo fmt --all --check`
   + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode checks only if
   touched; counts recorded; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates as
   DEFERRALS rows with owner/trigger/control; ADRs for owned decisions;
   run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; O-01–O-08 and I-01–I-08 dispositions
   (AC-5).

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-ledger/src/store.rs` — stamp
   `created_at_ms{value,measured_at:"runtime"}` on the seq-0
   `lifecycle.run.created` payload at `open_run` (the persisted created
   origin on the store's clock — the same authority `sink.now_ms()`
   answers; a recorded member, never a `ts` read). Tolerant decode:
   `RunManifest::from_json` preserves the member in `extra` → byte-stable
   round-trip; old rows simply lack it.
2. `crates/hh-env/src/driver.rs` — `WorkspaceSeal` owner record +
   `EnvDriver::seal_workspace(store, lease) -> Vec<WorkspaceSeal>`:
   per Ready handle — `path_baseline` end-state pin (snapshot row marked
   `purpose:"submission_seal"`) → `detach` revocation
   (`reason:"submission_seal"`) → `sample_meters` final usage row; leg
   failures recorded truthfully, revocation still attempted. Per
   Detached handle — recover the prior `submission_seal` pair (crash-
   between-seal-and-finish resume) or `unavailable{detached}`; other
   states → `unavailable{state}`. Factor `path_baseline`/`detach` bodies
   into `_inner` variants carrying the purpose/reason (public APIs keep
   today’s spellings byte-identical).
3. `crates/hh-control/src/driver.rs` — finish(): after the completion
   gate + `strategy.terminate`/`drain_ref`, run the seal through
   `sink.dispatch_seam()` when `envs` is armed; cite the per-handle seal
   records as `submission_seal` on `lifecycle.run.finished` (member
   absent on seam-less/host/replay paths — legacy byte-identical). M1
   `wall_ms` ← `created_origin_wall_ms`: `now − run.created.
   created_at_ms.value` on the producing clock; `n/a{observability}`
   unstamped, `n/a{untrustworthy_origin}` on clock-rollback (never a
   backdated finish). `turn_e2e_ms` stays turn-origin (M2, separate).
4. Tests: `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_10.rs` (seal battery: positive legs,
   prior recovery, detached-for-other-reason, non-ready states,
   post-seal mutation divergence, leg refusal truth) + driver unit tests
   (created-origin wall_ms incl. rollback/na legs; `submission_seal`
   member presence under armed seam; drain truth preserved) + store test
   (`created_at_ms` stamp + manifest round-trip).
5. ADR-0389 (owned decisions) + revisit triggers; run ledger; PR; close.
